name: Bonk Inc. Common Stock
summary: Operating from its headquarters in Jupiter, Florida, Safety Shot, Inc. supplies a variety of consumer goods across the United States, including numerous over-the-counter (OTC) remedies. A primary product is their "Safety Shot Beverage," an OTC drink specifically formulated to reduce blood alcohol levels. The company's diverse portfolio also features treatments for hair thinning, vitiligo solutions, eczema creams, and a range of sexual wellness items. These products reach customers through various channels, encompassing direct sales, partnerships with distributors and retailers, and online e-commerce platforms. Established in 2018, the entity previously operated as Jupiter Wellness, Inc. before officially adopting the name Safety Shot, Inc. in September 2023.
